caveats: Six seeds per phase repeat across two months and two outfits; scenario counts are not independent seed counts.
No game rules or study decisions were tuned to either phase.
Care-aware bundles labor, grain resupply and emergency slaughter; differences do not isolate one action causally.
No replacement-animal buying or live-animal sale optimization. This is not an optimal-human-player evaluation.

Existing ration logic switches everyone to Filling if any active traveler is below 80 health or ill. Normal buying retains $20; emergency buying keeps $10 while a future toll remains. These decision rules can constrain survival independently of livestock.
Dairy units eaten are milk/eggs only; emergency meat is reported separately as gross food added.
Raw shortage/rest totals have unequal exposure when parties die earlier; travel-day differences use paired arrivals only.
Unmet food is for the main party's requested meals; offscreen hunting provisions/returns have separate field audit.
